displayIdentity.body: A collection is arranged for Jerusalem. Now about the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise. If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
displayIdentity.title: A collection is arranged for Jerusalem
